errand_book.page.ask:
%1$s, of %2$s, asks this of you in their own hand:

%3$s

When it is done, bring it to me, and to no one else. I will see you paid.
errand_book.page.rare:
%1$s, of %2$s.

I would not nail this up where anyone may read it. My people kept the way into a ruin the hill has swallowed, an old people's, from before the long defence. It lies near %3$s, %4$s. Dig for what they left, and bring it to me.
errand_book.page.where: You will find %5$s at about %1$s, %2$s: some %3$s blocks %4$s of where you took this. They go back there when the day is done. The errand ends with them.
